claims.content: The Rahmenvorgaben describe the central language requirements for subject teaching (Fachunterricht) in all subjects of general-education schools, plus didactic principles for a language-sensitive subject teaching.

The core of the framework is the competency matrix (Kompetenzmatrix) Sprachbildung, which sets out subject-related language requirements the subject teaching places on students to work on subject tasks and successfully take part in the grade level.
claims.cited_text: Kern des Rahmenplanes ist die Kompetenzmatrix

claims.content: The matrix exists in two versions: one for primary school (Grundschule) with notes on extended requirements, and one for Sekundarstufe I with notes on higher requirements in Sekundarstufe II.
claims.cited_text: Die Kompetenzmatrix liegt in zwei Fassungen vor

claims.content: The didactic principles apply to all school stages because they do not differ.
The overview serves as an orientation frame and planning instrument for the systematic implementation of continuous language education (Sprachbildung).

Language competencies of the matrix are assigned to the topic fields and contents of the core curricula (Kerncurricula) via references, orienting teachers on which subject-related language actions to explicitly address and practise.
claims.cited_text: sprachliche Kompetenzen der Kompetenzmatrix durch Verweise zugeordnet

claims.content: It also serves as a support instrument for systematic integrative and additive support of students who learned German as a second language in an international preparatory class (the so-called 3. Phase).
claims.cited_text: Deutsch als Zweitsprache in einer Interna

claims.content: Exemplary linguistic means and hints for realizing the language actions on word, sentence, text and discourse level are provided to support language-sensitive lesson planning.
